verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a SaaS feedback and support platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions one. The REST API, the AI-friendly edit endpoint and llms.txt are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
